catalog_metadata.scope: Grid-tied residential rooftop solar PV, homeowner-installed, Cebu City, Philippines. Homeowner-produced documents only, per CLOSED-document-scope.md.

permits.name: Building Permit
permits.issuing_agency: Cebu City Office of the Building Official (OBO)
permits.legal_basis: Presidential Decree No. 1096 (National Building Code of the Philippines); for the RE-retrofit case, DILG-DPWH-DICT-DTI Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2021-01 governs the process per JMC 001-2026 Section 6.
permits.processing_time_note: No numeric fee schedule located from a primary source; fees are reportedly computed from an itemized assessment.
unverified_notes: No primary source found stating a kW threshold below which the Building Permit is waived for a retrofit; treat 'always required for retrofits' as the safe assumption.
Fee schedule for a residential solar retrofit specifically is unverified — no numeric figure located.
Whether the Cebu City OBO portal (mics.cebucity.gov.ph/obo) supports full online submission or only tracking is unverified.

permits.name: Electrical Permit
permits.legal_basis: JMC 001-2026 Section 6.1.1 (streamlined track, for existing permitted establishments); otherwise bundled into the standard Building Permit application as item 4 (Electrical Permit Application Form). RA 7920 and the Philippine Electrical Code govern the underlying electrical work standards.
permits.processing_time_note: Not more than 3 working days under JMC 001-2026 Section 6.1.1.3 ('simple' complexity category); deemed approved if the LGU misses this window, per RA 11032 Section 10.

permits.name: Certificate of Final Electrical Inspection (CFEI)
permits.issuing_agency: Cebu City OBO (Building Official), after physical inspection
permits.processing_time_note: Not more than 7 working days under JMC 001-2026 Section 6.1.2.3 ('complex' complexity category); deemed approved if the LGU misses this window, per RA 11032 Section 10.
unverified_notes: A secondary source quotes a DOE official describing 3 working days for CFEI, which conflicts with the primary JMC text's 7 working days. The primary JMC text is authoritative here.

permits.name: Net-Metering Agreement / Application (Visayan Electric)
permits.legal_basis: JMC 001-2026 Section 5.3, citing the DOE Net-Metering Guidebook 2022 (p.18), tracing to RA 9513 Section 4 (distributed generation cap).
permits.processing_time_note: Distribution utilities must process complete applications within 10 working days effective 1 April 2026 (down from 20 days).
unverified_notes: Actual hosting-capacity limits on a given transformer are assessed case by case during VECO's Distribution Impact Study, not a flat published number.
Interconnection fee of PHP 8,000-15,000 is cited only by secondary sources, unconfirmed against a VECO fee schedule.

documents.title: Locational Clearance
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 10 (Form OBO-FM-PII-B-36, v.00, Eff. Date May 15, 2023).
documents.expiry_note: Checklist notes it is 'typically time-bound' but states no explicit validity window. [UNVERIFIED]

documents.title: Barangay Clearance
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 12.
documents.expiry_note: No Cebu-specific validity window found on the primary checklist. General Philippine practice is commonly cited elsewhere as 6 months to 1 year, but that figure is not confirmed for Cebu. [UNVERIFIED]

documents.title: Homeowners' Association Clearance (or Affidavit of No Homeowners' Association)
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 13.

documents.title: Certified True Copy of Lot Title (TCT)
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 14.
documents.expiry_note: No explicit validity window stated, though it must be a 'certified true copy', implying recency.

documents.title: Certified True Copy of Lot Tax Declaration
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 15.

documents.title: Certified True Copy of Lot Tax Clearance
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 16.
documents.expiry_note: Annual — reflects current-year real property tax payment status.

documents.title: Deed of Absolute Sale (notarized)
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 17 — required only if the applicant is not the registered owner.

documents.title: Consent and Authority (notarized)
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 18 — required only if the applicant is not the registered owner.

documents.title: Contract of Lease for the Lot (notarized)
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 19 — required only if the applicant is not the registered owner.
documents.expiry_note: Has a lease term / expiry, not a fixed duration on the checklist.

documents.title: Special Power of Attorney (notarized)
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 24 — required if the applicant acts via a representative. Triggered either by the applicant not being the registered owner, or by the registered owner delegating the act of filing to a representative (e.g. their installer) while remaining the owner. The second trigger is inferred from the checklist's SPA line plus generic practice, not independently confirmed as Cebu-OBO-specific. [UNVERIFIED as Cebu-OBO-specific policy]

documents.title: Occupancy Certificate
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 20 — required for renovation projects, of which a solar retrofit is one.

documents.title: Certified True Copy of Tax Declaration & Tax Clearance for the Building (if no Occupancy Certificate)
documents.legal_basis: Cebu City OBO Building Permit Requirements Checklist, item 21 — alternative to the Occupancy Certificate for renovation projects.
documents.expiry_note: Annual, for the tax clearance portion.

documents.title: Valid Government-Issued ID
documents.legal_basis: Visayan Electric net-metering application requirements — 'Valid IDs & Proof of Ownership'.
documents.expiry_note: VECO's page does not specify an ID type or expiry rule. [UNVERIFIED]

documents.title: Proof of Ownership
documents.legal_basis: Visayan Electric net-metering application requirements — 'Valid IDs & Proof of Ownership'.
documents.expiry_note: VECO does not specify the exact accepted document type beyond 'proof of ownership'. [UNVERIFIED]

documents.title: Electrical Single Line Diagram (service entrance to main breaker, showing solar connection, 3 sets)
documents.legal_basis: JMC 001-2026 Section 6.1.1.1(b) — signed and sealed by a registered Electrical Engineer.
